issues.text: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate's return type was changed from list[DetectorEvaluationResult] to dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but its docstring still says it "returns a list" — a silent mismatch since both types can be iterated with `for x in results`, just yielding different things.
issues.zh: evaluate 的回傳型別由 list 改為 dict，docstring 仍寫「returns a list」

issues.text: The new test assertions on IssueOccurrence are effectively empty: IssueOccurrence.__eq__ only compares `id`, and the test helper build_mock_occurrence_and_event hardcodes the same id string for every occurrence it builds, so any two occurrences produced by the helper compare equal regardless of fingerprint, group_key, priority, or other content — meaning this PR's main new assertions verify nothing, as demonstrated by two tests whose expected values already don't match what's actually produced yet still pass.
issues.zh: 測試對 IssueOccurrence 的斷言全部是空的——IssueOccurrence.__eq__ 只比一個欄位（id），而 mock 對所有 occurrence 都寫死同一個 id，兩者相乘的結果是任何兩個由這個 helper 產生的 IssueOccurrence 都相等，不管 fingerprint、group_key、priority、project_id、detection_time 差多少

issues.text: MetricAlertDetectorHandler's base class was changed such that it now inherits four unimplemented abstract methods, making it non-instantiable (ABCMeta), yet it is still registered on MetricAlertFire.detector_handler; accessing detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire Detector will raise TypeError, and mypy won't catch it because the declared type is a `type[X] | None` union which suppresses the type-abstract check.
issues.zh: MetricAlertDetectorHandler 變成無法實例化的抽象類別，卻仍註冊在 MetricAlertFire.detector_handler 上

issues.text: A TODO comment ("This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction") describing work that this very PR completed was left in place instead of being removed.
issues.zh: 已經被這次變更完成的 TODO 註解沒有移除

issues.text: The test helper parameter name `type` in create_detector_and_conditions shadows the builtin `type`, and reads awkwardly since `type` in this codebase is also a Detector field name and a GroupType concept.
issues.zh: 測試 helper 的參數名 type 蓋掉 builtin

issues.text: TestProcessDetectors.setUp is a no-op override that only calls super().setUp(), a leftover remnant from merging StatefulDetectorHandlerTestMixin into BaseDetectorHandlerTest.
issues.zh: TestProcessDetectors.setUp（:125-126）現在只有 super().setUp() 一行，等同於不覆寫

issues.text: build_handler's detector_type parameter is never passed by any of its ten call sites in the file, making it a dead/unused parameter left over from the test refactor.
issues.zh: build_handler(self, detector=None, detector_type=None) 的 detector_type 參數，檔案裡十處呼叫全部是無參數的 self.build_handler()，沒有任何 caller 傳值

issues.text: The `import builtins` / `builtins.type[GroupType]` workaround (needed because the Detector model has a field literally named `type`, which shadows the builtin inside the class body) is correct but has no explanatory comment, making it likely a future "cleanup" will revert it back to `type[GroupType]` and break CI again.
issues.zh: builtins.type[GroupType] 這個規避寫法是對的，但沒有註解說明，下一個人很可能會把它「簡化」回去

open_questions.text: Is MetricAlertDetectorHandler being left as `pass` a deliberate placeholder (pending a future stateful implementation), or was it an oversight when the base class was changed?
open_questions.zh: MetricAlertDetectorHandler 留成 pass 是刻意的佔位（等 metric alert 的 stateful 實作），還是這次改基底類別時漏掉的？

open_questions.text: Detector.project_id is still hardcoded to return 1; now that this change wires up actually producing and sending IssueOccurrence to Kafka, what mechanism prevents occurrences from being written against project 1 before a real project_id is added to the model?
open_questions.zh: Detector.project_id 仍然是寫死的 1；在真正的 detector 上線之前，有什麼機制擋住 occurrence 被寫到 project 1？

open_questions.text: The occurrence is sent to Kafka before commit_state_updates() runs; if the commit fails, will the next data packet re-produce the same occurrence (a duplicate issue) rather than just a duplicate resolve as before?
open_questions.zh: occurrence 在 commit_state_updates() 之前就送進 Kafka；若 commit 失敗，下一個 data packet 會不會重複產生同一個 occurrence？

open_questions.text: Was removing the duplicate-group-key detection and its logger.error call a deliberate transfer of responsibility to each handler, or just incidental cleanup once the return type became a dict? If deliberate, is the new "keys must be unique and match result.group_key" contract documented anywhere?
open_questions.zh: 拿掉重複 group key 的偵測與那行 logger.error("Duplicate detector state group keys found")，是刻意把責任移交給 handler，還是型別改成 dict 之後的順手清理？如果是刻意的，這個新契約有打算寫下來嗎？
